name: Chapter II
summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, Barnil Stonepot searches for leaves missing from Hemet Nesingwary's manuscript. He gathered most of them himself, but travelers must help find the rest.

sections.title: Hunts of the Jungle Cats
sections.body: Barnil Stonepot has recovered many leaves from Hemet Nesingwary's scattered manuscript across Stranglethorn Vale. The second chapter follows panthers and tigers through the wilderness. Pages ten, eleven, fourteen, and sixteen remain missing, so those hunting accounts are incomplete.

faq.q: Who is asking for these manuscript pages?
faq.answer: Barnil Stonepot, who helps the Nesingwary expedition in Stranglethorn Vale, asks for the missing leaves.

faq.q: Which pages are needed for the second chapter?
faq.answer: Barnil needs pages ten, eleven, fourteen, and sixteen for the second chapter.

faq.q: What stories are recorded in the second chapter?
faq.answer: The second chapter tells of stalking and hunting the panthers and tigers that prowl Stranglethorn Vale.
Barnil's request follows his first call for help recovering Hemet Nesingwary's scattered manuscript, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.
